title: A Chord Tutorial: Open A Major with Alternative Fingering (JustinGuitar)
summary: JustinGuitar's beginner lesson demonstrates an alternative fingering for the open A major chord. The tutorial shows placing the 2nd and 3rd fingers on the 2nd fret of the 4th and 2nd strings respectively, with the 1st finger tucked between them on the 2nd fret 3rd string, to produce a clean A chord with less pressure. It discusses muting issues, string-by-string checks (5th through thinner string), transitions to D and E chords, and common finger placement problems. The video also emphasizes quick, regular practice and introduces the 'Chord Perfect' approach for building chord confidence.
